description:
How many adults do voluntary work for an organisation or group, and what share of residents aged 15 and over that is, for every suburb and council area.

Coverage: About 10,500 suburbs and localities and 545 council areas across Australia, in all states and territories (areas with too few people or homes for reliable figures are left out); one snapshot at 10 August 2021. Current to 2021-08-10. Full description, field list and method: `/v1/datasets/volunteering`.

**Price: 5¢ per call.**

fields.description: Comma-separated subset of: total_aged_15_plus, volunteers_count, volunteers_pct, not_volunteers_count, not_volunteers_pct, volunteering_not_stated_count, volunteering_not_stated_pct. Omit for all.

lga_name.description: Council (LGA) name exactly as /v1/lga/list returns it, e.g. `Lake Macquarie`.

to.description: Last period to include, same formats as `from`.

name: lga_area_stats_volunteering
title: LGA · Volunteering
